topic.source_contract: NHS healthcare planning, capital and developer-contribution evidence

facts.basis: statistical allocation formula reflecting healthcare need
facts.guard: financial allocation is not facility capacity, appointment availability or project delivery

facts.primary_care: BAU, GP IT and strategic investment routes
facts.guard: capital category and allocation are not candidate-specific funded construction

facts.primary_care: improve access and commission additional capacity for out-of-hours and surge periods
facts.guard: system expectation is not a site-level service or premises commitment

facts.duty: ICBs and partner trusts prepare joint capital resource use plans
facts.guard: joint plan is not project approval, land ownership or completion evidence

facts.housing_growth: additional facilities may require developer contributions
facts.guard: policy and potential contribution are not executed agreement, receipt or delivered health facility

scope_guards: ICB financial allocations are not local premises capacity or appointment availability.
Operational and strategic capital routes remain distinct.
A joint capital resource use plan is not an approved or delivered project.
Primary-care access expectations are not a candidate-specific service commitment.
Section 106 and CIL mechanisms are not executed healthcare contributions.
National or ICB funding is not evidence of land ownership, planning permission or construction.
System-level need and weighted-population formulas are not parcel demand or viability scores.
Exact population impact, ICB response, agreement, funded scheme, site and delivery evidence is required.
